proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config/env fields are validated, defaulted, stored, and synchronized during communicator initialization. Enqueue review is also required because graphUsageMode materially changes strong-stream graph/uncaptured synchronization and P2P plan channel throttling. Device-topology review is required for substantive P2P channel-per-peer logic changes in graph path/channel computation, including explicit net-peer channel demand and maxP2pPeers-based tuning.
